name: school-task-tracker
description: A multi-role school task & checklist tracker — demo build with local mock data, no backend or API keys required.

paragraphs: A multi-role task, checklist, and operations-tracking system for schools. Four roles — Organization Owner, Campus Manager, Department Lead, and Staff Member — each get a purpose-built dashboard for assigning, tracking, escalating, and reporting on work across departments and branches.

This is a self-contained demo build. It runs entirely on an in-memory mock data layer — no real backend, no database, no API keys, no network calls. Clone it, run two commands, and the whole app — auth, data, notifications, the works — just works out of the box. Read on for exactly how that's done, and how to swap in a real backend when you're ready.

Rewriting every page's data-fetching to call some bespoke mock API would have meant touching 40 files and maintaining two code paths forever. Aliasing at the import level means the mock layer is a drop-in for the real SDK: swapping back to a live Firebase project later is a config change, not a rewrite — see the next section.
features: Organization Owner — global view across the whole organization
Cross-branch dashboard: completion rate, overdue tasks, user/branch counts
User management (create/edit/deactivate any role, reset passwords)
Org-wide checklist oversight and task reports
Support desk — issues raised by Staff Members and Department Leads land here
